description: This file contains schema definitions, index creation, and seed data for a virus threats database in a PostgreSQL environment. It defines tables related to threats, scan jobs, scan results, detections, schedules, and protection events, along with some initial seed data for threat signatures.
calls: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS threats
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scan_jobs
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scan_results
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS detections
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schedules
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS protection_events
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS threats_signature_uidx
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS scan_jobs_status_idx
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS detections_job_id_idx
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS schedules_enabled_idx
